summary: Comprehensive multi-level test suite with strong coverage of all task requirements. Unit tests (test_artifact_cleanup.py) exercise TDD red-green approach covering artifact parsing, all three retention policies (max_age, keep_latest_n, max_total_size), policy composition with precedence, config loading, error handling, CLI integration, and dry-run/live modes. Workflow structure tests (test_workflow.py) validate YAML correctness, triggers, job dependencies, permissions, matrix fixture coverage, and actionlint compliance. Integration harness (run_act_tests.py) runs the full workflow via act with exact output assertions on fixture cases. Gaps: missing edge cases like zero-byte artifacts, identical timestamps, extreme policy values (e.g., max_total_size=0 or smaller than any artifact). Design is well-organized with clear separation of concerns (unit/structure/integration layers), good use of fixtures and helpers, and reproducible tests via injected time. However, run_act_tests.py is complex, and string-based output matching in the act harness could be fragile. All tests are well-documented and follow TDD discipline. Would catch most regressions though some corner cases might escape.
